verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is described as an API-first product (comm-1), and the docs show API coverage for core operations. These include creating cards and cardholders, spending controls, and real-time authorization decisioning. Disputes and funding details are explicitly offered through both the Dashboard and the API, and an official CLI and MCP server extend programmatic access. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party statement of full Dashboard-to-API parity, no evidence that UI-oriented features such as physical card design/branding configuration are API-accessible, and no independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
